correctness.rationale: The rank-one factorization and nondegenerate trace pairing reduce the defining anti identity (checked, not inferred from ordinary Rota-Baxter) to U^2=lambda U, VU=aV, UV=bV, lambda+a+b=0. Nilpotent U forces a=b=0. For normalized idempotent E the side eigenvalues are 0 or 1, giving precisely the p=2 offdiagonal and p=3 diagonal cases. Scalar ambiguity is removed by output line or uniquely normalized E. Counts are exact Grassmann/complement/isomorphism counts and trace fibers, with characteristic-free Gaussians. Distinct types are disjoint. Direct original-identity computations exhaust (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(2,5) and check every canonical allowed pair at (3,2); no finite test substitutes for the proof. The n>=2 restriction is necessary for the nonstrongness argument.

originality.rationale: The source defining anti-Rota-Baxter maps assumes characteristic zero and does not discuss the new modular rank-one full-matrix census. The closest matrix-algebra rank-one classifications have the opposite ordinary Rota-Baxter sign and therefore do not imply the characteristic-three EVE branch or its composition-eigenvalue mass. The prior characteristic-three anti-Rota-Baxter dual-number result concerns a commutative two-dimensional local algebra and cannot imply a full matrix algebra formula. A mathematically related anti-Rota-Baxter classification for a coordinatewise product algebra has different zero-divisor and component behavior and cannot imply the full matrix-algebra result. Relevant full texts were read where available; indexed-only sources are disclosed as a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: The ordinary matrix RB published records were available through indexed abstracts, not complete texts, so publication priority is not conclusively settled.
Historical coverage of earlier similar scientific findings remains incomplete and cannot establish global uniqueness.
The anti-Rota-Baxter literature beyond the primary 2022 source could contain equivalent positive-characteristic statements not surfaced by searching.

value.rationale: Determines a natural entire all-dimensional rank-one operator problem on simple associative matrix algebras, distinguishing strong versus general anti operators. Its characteristic-three EVE branch yields genuinely nonnilpotent maps absent from all other characteristics, a sharp spectral obstruction and exact prescribed-eigenvalue census. This is not a cosmetic substitution into the ordinary rank-one Rota-Baxter census: that ordinary identity prohibits the new branch. The formula applies uniformly in n and q including extension fields and produces nontrivial arithmetic counts and structural normal forms.
